_comment: InjectMe L3 rollup configuration for OP Stack with 0G DA

l1._comment: L1 block at which the L3 rollup was deployed. Set by deploy script.

l2._comment: L3 genesis block hash. Set by deploy script after genesis init.

system_config._comment: System config read from L1 SystemConfigProxy at genesis.

alt_da._comment_type: GenericCommitment means the DA server generates commitments, not the chain.
alt_da._comment_challenge: Challenge contract is zero-address when not using on-chain DA challenges.
alt_da._comment_windows: Challenge and resolve windows in L1 blocks. 160 blocks at ~12s = ~32 minutes.
alt_da._comment_resolve: Time allowed to resolve a DA challenge, also in L1 blocks.
